implementation.behavior: Native plugin reads PNG and any co-present plain text only after a paste action. Text is inserted at the active selection; image bytes enter the existing TEXT/DM-scoped upload queue and never enter the message body. The queue enforces 10 attachments, 25 MB per image, pending/error/507/retry states and drops stale reads after a conversation switch.

checks.name: Clipboard payload, text and size handling
checks.observation: Three tests cover mixed text+PNG payloads, an image above the 25 MB upload limit, and an empty clipboard.

checks.name: Composer queue and scope
checks.observation: Tests cover insertion at the selected range, image upload through TEXT, stale read cancellation after a channel switch, preserving text when image size is rejected, and participant-scoped DM upload with 507 retry using the same clipboard bytes.

checks.name: Full Flutter suite and static analysis
checks.observation: All 130 Flutter tests passed; analyzer reported no issues.

checks.name: macOS native plugin integration
checks.observation: Debug BOOHTACORD.app built with ClipboardPlugin registered. The app was not manually run against a real system clipboard.

checks.name: Android native plugin integration
checks.observation: Debug APK built with ClipboardPlugin registered. AndroidX requires compileSdk 34, while clipboard 3.0.14 pins its library to 33; android/build.gradle.kts raises compileSdk to 34 for only that library and leaves app targetSdk unchanged. The pre-existing Kotlin Gradle Plugin warning for flutter_background/flutter_webrtc/livekit_client remains.

checks.name: Windows native build and real clipboard acceptance
checks.reason: No Windows build runner or attached device/clipboard session was available. Actual Ctrl/Cmd+V, Shift+Insert, menu/context action, macOS paste prompt, Android URI lifetime, Windows DIB conversion, live 507 and switching during native read must still be tested on each OS.

privacy: The client does not monitor or poll the clipboard. A read is initiated only by the user's keyboard shortcut, selection-menu action or explicit paste button. Clipboard image bytes are uploaded using the current conversation identifier and are not serialized into message text.
remaining: Verify real clipboard paste, permissions/URI lifetime, 25 MB rejection, retry and conversation switching on macOS, Windows and Android; compile the Windows client on a Windows runner.
